title.zh: 将北三宝颜省Katipunan中学改设为Batac农村中学类型的国立农村中学，名称为Katipunan国立农村中学，并授权为此拨款
title.en: An Act to Convert the Katipunan High School in the Province of Zamboanga del Norte to a National Rural High School of the Batac Rural High School Type, to be Known as the Katipunan National Rural High School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds for the Purpose
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Katipunan High School in the Province of Zamboanga del Norte to a National Rural High School of the Batac Rural High School Type, to be Known as the Katipunan National Rural High School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds for the Purpose

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1565_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Katipunan High School, situated in the Municipality of Katipunan, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, is hereby converted to a national rural high school of the Batac Rural High School type, to be known as the Katipunan National Rural High School.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation and maintenance of the Katipunan National Rural High School during the school year nineteen hundred fifty-five to nineteen hundred fifty-six. Thereafter, the necessary sum for said purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
